purpose: Specifies the .doc_structure.yaml format that declares document locations and types for rules and specs, used by forge to resolve paths and search index targets.
summary: Overview of the project-level config file and its consumers
File placement at the project root
Schema for rules and specs categories with root_dirs, doc_types_map, patterns
root_dirs rules and glob support for single-level and recursive matching
doc_types_map and recommended doc_type names for specs and rules
doc_types forge resolves locations from and behavior when undeclared or duplicated
patterns.exclude matching rules and exclusion of plan from the index
Samples: flat, feature-based, nested, with exclude
Consumer guide: resolve_doc_structure.py usage and path hand-off to the document search index
tasks: Resolving document paths in a forge skill
Configuring search index target paths and exclusions
Adding a feature directory or doc_type
title: .doc_structure.yaml フォーマット仕様
